firstMessage.rawMarkdown:
Hi,

When I submit a notebook to the ARC-AGI-3 competition, I notice that two processes start:

The actual competition submission run.
A second notebook execution, even though I didn't click Save & Run.

I have a few questions:

Does this second notebook execution consume my GPU quota?
If I cancel the second notebook, does it affect the competition submission, its score, or its logs in any way?
I've also noticed that if there's an error, this second notebook usually fails almost immediately, while the actual competition submission continues running for much longer. Why does this happen? Are these two executions running in different environments or serving different purposes?

Thanks!
